data.long_meaning: Derived from the Japanese words 'hiro' meaning wide and 'ko' meaning child. The name Hiroko symbolizes a shining light or a radiant child. The name Hiroko carries the meaning “Shining Light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Japanese. Parents who choose Hiroko usually hope their child will grow to embody shining light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
